name: Independent Timber Merchants Co-operative Limited
note: New Zealand building-supplies co-operative behind the ITM brand. Its website describes a co-operative of over 90 independently owned stores whose members are shareholders (itm.co.nz/about-us/join-itm); the Companies Register lists its shares in parcels held by the member stores' companies, the largest 8.20% (register fetched 2026-09-30).
